title: helianthemum glaucum subsp. croceum
intro: Helianthemum glaucum subsp. croceum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Cistaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum glaucum subsp. croceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
